title: thalictrum angustifolium subsp. galioides
intro: Thalictrum angustifolium subsp. galioides, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Meadow Rue include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects.
